rides.board: Bathurst St at Bloor St West
rides.alight: Bathurst St at Dundas St West  - Toronto Western Hospital

kept.quote: The following low-ridership bus stops are proposed to be removed: Dewbourne Avenue, Ardmore Road, Heathdale Road and Barton Avenue.
kept.summary: The City proposes removing four low-ridership Bathurst Street bus stops as part of the Bathurst Street priority transit lanes plan.
kept.why_it_matters: These named stops do not appear to be your boarding or alighting stops, but the same Bathurst Street plan may change how buses on your corridor run and stop.

kept.quote: Note that the proposed priority transit lanes, parking and turning prohibitions and stop removals are part of the ongoing consultation with local Councillors and the public and are subject to change based on feedback received.
kept.summary: The Bathurst Street transit lane, parking, turning and stop removal proposals are still under consultation and may change.
kept.why_it_matters: The list of affected Bathurst Street stops could change during consultation, so stops near Bloor or Dundas may or may not end up included.

kept.quote: To maximize the benefit of the priority transit lanes, existing on-street parking is being considered for removal, with “no-stopping” regulations implemented where the lanes are installed.
kept.summary: On-street parking along the Bathurst Street priority transit lanes is being considered for removal, with no-stopping rules where lanes are installed.
kept.why_it_matters: Changes to the curb lane on Bathurst could affect where the bus pulls up to the curb when you board or get off.
